incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING — billing-metric-anomaly detected (token_count delta). Affected: hosted-prod eu-west-1. Severity: P2. First observed 10:12 UTC. Probe: token_count_agg delta > 25% over 10m. https://ops.redwood/incidents/5319991234

Emily (oncall): ack. Investigating. @Raj can you confirm billing pipeline?

Raj (billing): seeing a surge in token emits from proxy cluster in eu-west-1, but shadow-agg shows a delayed window. counts jumping then late emits. Suspect emitter retry loop. I can run quick check.

Emily (oncall): run `curl -s https://metrics.redwood/api/query?m=token_count.delta` and paste top lines

Raj (billing): pasted snippet:
```
proxy.emits.eu-west-1  2026-03-19T10:11  +42%
emitter.retry_count    2026-03-19T10:12  +120
ledger.ingest.delay    2026-03-19T10:13  00:54s
```

billing-bot: Automated alert: "usage-pipeline-lag" consumer lag > 180s for stream billing-events-eu. Current backlog: 1.2M events.

Emily (oncall): :eyes: is customer-facing overage flags firing?

billing-bot: Yes, 14 accounts flagged with potential overage. Alert IDs: OV-9853..OV-9866. Some are trial accounts.

Irene (CS): pinged. Preparing customer notice draft. Which customers to notify?

Raj (billing): prioritize enterprise customers with manual monitoring: acme-corp, bluebird, stately-inc. For others we can batch.

Emily (oncall): Mitigation options:
- stop shadow emitter (low-risk)
- throttle proxy retries (needs dev-ops)
- temporary ratecap lift? (costy)
Which gives fastest reduction?

Alex (sre): stopping shadow emitter is quickest. Command:
`kubectl -n infra scale deploy shadow-emitter --replicas=0`
Will need revert after backfill.

Morgan (oncall-next): I'll take handoff at 10:30 UTC. If you scale shadow-emitter down, I will watch backlog and trigger controlled re-ingest once backlog < 50k.

Emily (oncall): Doing scale now. Executing: `kubectl -n infra scale deploy shadow-emitter --replicas=0` :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

Emily (oncall): scaled to 0. Watching metrics.

Raj (billing): seeing retry_count drop, delta smoothing. Also starting small backfill window for affected customers to reconcile counts later.

billing-bot: Emit lag decreased to 32s after 2m. Overage flags set to "investigating". No billing charges yet.

Irene (CS): Draft sent to legal & comms. Suggest message: "We're investigating delayed usage reporting; you may see temporary overage flags, no charges applied until reconciliation." Want to send to priority customers now?

Emily (oncall): Yes send to acme-corp and bluebird. Mark as "informational".

Morgan (oncall-next): at 10:30 pick up. Noted.

Emily (oncall): handoff: I'm heading OOO at 10:35. Status: shadow emitter scaled down, backlog 18k, customers flagged 14 (enterprise priority 3). Next steps: monitor for residual late emits and coordinate backfill. Paging cleared but keep incident channel open. :white_check_mark: 

incident-bot: Incident status changed: mitigated -> monitoring. Incident owner: Emily. Handoff to Morgan at 10:30 UTC.

Morgan (oncall-next): ack. I'll set a watch and create a quick runbook entry in /runbooks/billing/delayed-usage-2026-03-19.

Alex (sre): FYI we should add a circuit-breaker to emitter retries to prevent amplification. Filing jitter ticket: ENG-7312.

Emily (oncall): thanks all. Closing thread for now, will update with postmortem items.
